verdict: Only for a team with deep medical-device expertise. Vivalyf Innovations pitched a prickless diabetes testing machine on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. India has one of the world's largest diabetic populations, so the market is huge, but non-invasive glucose testing is one of the hardest problems in medical technology, and accuracy must be proven clinically.
angle: Finger-prick testing is painful, so many diabetics test less than they should. A reliable non-invasive device would be very valuable, but global companies have spent years on it. Clinical accuracy, CDSCO approval and doctor trust decide whether the product can sell at all.
